text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when both the Aoharu Cup and the Twinkle Series
had settled down, Chairwoman Akikawa summoned the team.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Through all the peaks and valleys,
you've run brilliantly to make it this far!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"And above all, congratulations on winning
the Aoharu Cup! Truly moving, deeply inspiring...!
It was a magnificent race!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Displaying the full force of teamwork forged since the team's inception,
they bravely take on the finals!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"And that fierce battle with Team First,
everyone held their breath and looked on in awe!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Your team's strength is worthy of the highest praise!
Bravo, splendid work!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And so! Now that things have settled down,
as a special bonus, I present you with
a ticket for a Carrot BBQ outing!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to your future exploits!
Go forth and spread your wings to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And on top of that—!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"To all of you glorious competitors!
I would like to present this supplementary prize!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A miraculous supplementary prize
worthy of the name "Harenohi Runners"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? C-C-Could this really be!?
A "Kokopelli Doll of Happiness"!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! I purchased it in Arizona,
praying for happiness and success!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat! What an ultra-rare item!!
Thank you so muuuuch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With such a wonderful extra prize,
the team's morale soared!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And thus—!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Everyone, please raise your glasses, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: CHEEEEEERS!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: CHEEEEEERS!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's yummy, isn't it, Rice-chan! And there are
still soooo many more carrots left!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
We owe it all to Chairwoman Akikawa~!
Bless her, truly bless her.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! A BBQ on the wide open beach!
Soooo delicious!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, having a fun party with teammates
is super duper fun after all, yes!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: A party celebrating overcoming three whole years is packed with memories! It's so special, YES!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I see. So our three years together
have been this heartwarming and fulfilling, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Which one is the piping hot 'three-year sweet potato'?
I wanna eat one too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I think that might just be a figure of speech, Urara-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the team members enjoy themselves in their own ways,
I couldn't help but smile.
choice_data_list: (Things were really tough in the beginning...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower stopped showing up to training,
and I was challenged to an unsanctioned race...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For three years, this team has overcome the new path of the Team Competitions together.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san,
you're spacing out, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
If you don't eat it quickly, it will all be gone!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The best is yet to come, so make sure to energize yourself fully, ple-ase!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Here, Trainer,
I brought you some carrot juice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, Rice brought one too...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Really!?
Ahaha! Let's give it to them together, then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And just then, a familiar group arrived on the scene.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Gah.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence! Do you guys have
Carrot BBQ 'Off You Go' vouchers too?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! Everyone else too?!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Our team's results were recognized by the chairwoman too!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Well,
I doubt that is the only reason, however.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Hello, it's been quite a while, hasn't it?
Long time no see.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...When I received the tickets, Chairwoman Akikawa spoke
of you. She seems to have quite high expectations."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I was a little jealous... but it's fine.
I'm the type who enjoys climbing all the way to the top.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Now that you are my Trainer, we stand in the same ring.
I look forward to working with you from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The road still stretches far ahead.
I vowed with <chrname> that we would continue to give it our absolute best!
